status: Proposed coordination dimensions; research geometry, not fabrication certified
axes: X travel, Y across belt, Z up

host.status: Illustrative compatible host segment, not a machine offered for sale
host.context_omissions: Partial host segment; roller bearings, drive, turnaround belt curves and safety guards omitted. Host capability and installation approval unresolved.

module.mount_interface_status: Illustrative slotted adapter; selected fastener, host structure and load adequacy unresolved

lane.status: Constrained central experimental lane only; no validated coverage, fragment limit or throughput; outer lanes unused

flexible_skirt.status: Nominal contact only; wear, deflection, entrapment and escape require feed/belt tests

upstream_exclusion.status: Host must meter into lane before fixed exclusion mask; no approved operating feed, collision or jam-clearing behavior

optical.status: Device/lens/illumination and geometric footprint assumptions; no calibration or optical coverage validation

optional_3d_aim.status: Assumed centerline toward lane; field of view and calibration unvalidated

optical.lens_tip_z_definition: Lens barrel lower datum; glass lowest surface at 1443

under_belt.status: One Tx and two independent Rx windings with candidate differential pairing. Three drawn rectangular perimeter passes per winding are a proposed packaging topology, not an electrically selected or validated coil design.
under_belt.standoff_definition: 1000 minus maximum bare winding core Z, excluding separate terminal pins. Compare separate core, insulation and terminal extrema below.
under_belt.outer_size_definition: Nominal main-perimeter insulation envelope only; return and terminal tails extend beyond it.

winding_footprints_mm.excludes: Separate terminal pins and nonmetallic terminal inserts; use part bounds for the complete detail.

transverse.status: One transverse Tx and two opposite independent Rx windings; pairing, polarity and balance are unoptimized. Main paths are in XZ planes, with recessed out-of-plane returns. Reversal is not a new independent excitation direction.
transverse.outer_size_definition: Nominal main-perimeter insulation envelope only; return and terminal tails extend beyond it.

winding_footprints_mm.excludes: Separate terminal pins and nonmetallic terminal inserts; use part bounds for the complete detail.

exclusion_test_envelope.status: Illustrative reservation only; final extent measured with actual belt reinforcement, rollers, frames, fasteners, fragments and frequency range; intended coils and leads are inside

controls.status: Acquisition/control component envelopes; hardware, IO, safety, EMC and thermal design unselected

service.status: After isolation, access cover release, cable disconnection and external support; geometric scope only
service.under_belt_withdrawal_scope: Exact conservative swept box: X ±148, Y −1030…150, Z 930…980. Host rail top is 900, so the cartridge has 30 mm nominal vertical clearance; fixed rail bottoms at 910 have 10 mm. Tolerance, deflection and access validation remain open.

timing.status: Sequential stations, same-object association unvalidated. Encoder measures belt travel, not fragment travel. Last usable observation needs measured field/optical footprint.

deviations_from_parent_example.central_lane_mm: 180 vs optional 120; explicitly mechanical, not active coverage
deviations_from_parent_example.station_spacing_mm: 300 vs optional 200; sequential association remains required
deviations_from_parent_example.coil_count: Six functional windings: two Tx and four independently terminated Rx. M01-W1 draws three open rectangular perimeter passes per winding; electrical turn count and balance remain unselected.
deviations_from_parent_example.belt_datum_z_mm: 1000 retained for project coordination; carrying-surface-relative height equals Z−1000
deviations_from_parent_example.host_bridge_allocation_mm: 1240 portal spacing, no installed structural adequacy claim

adjustment_holds.under_belt: Two 3 mm removable nonmetallic spacers installed at each slide-end support. Positive clamps outside withdrawal path. Other pack heights, loads and repeatability unvalidated.
adjustment_holds.transverse: Actual 75 x 9 mm Y slots and 90 x 9 mm Z slots with retainers. Only the nominal pose is checked; complete travel/collision/locking strength/repeatability unvalidated.
adjustment_holds.host_mounts: Actual 24 x 9 mm slots and saddle and backing clamps. Only the 600 mm host interface is checked; loads/torques/tolerances/site fit unresolved.
adjustment_holds.optical: Actual 110 x 9 mm slot provision; lens, full field of view and calibration unselected.

calibration_accessory.status: Removable carrier with unselected reference coupon envelope. No calibration material, procedure, field map, repeatability or safety validation is established.

parameter_execution_scope: Host width and belt datum are directly consumed from JSON. Winding dimensions are source-bound constants in cad/windings.py. Other register dimensions require coordinated Python edits. Width variants are validity probes, not approved installation variants.

winding_geometry.turn_convention: Three nested rectangular perimeter passes. The spiral transitions and terminal return do not form three exact closed encirclements; electrical turn count is unselected.
winding_geometry.insulation_representation: Actual annular solid, default hidden to inspect bare conductor. Independent terminal pins overlap only their intended winding endpoints.
winding_geometry.groove_fit: Nominal matching insulation diameter with an open inspection/assembly slot. Fit tolerance, wire retention, material, winding manufacture, strain relief and dielectric qualification remain unselected.
winding_geometry.external_termination_hold: Visible individual start/finish pins end the internal winding model. Connection from these pins to the acquisition lead, shield/pair construction and circuit/pinout remain unresolved; no closed electrical circuit is claimed.
electrical_holds: Electrical turn count and wire construction
Winding sense, terminal polarity and Rx combination
Insulation, thermal rating, retention and manufacture
Measured field, host interaction, sensitivity and calibration
winding_geometry.separation_scope: Independent source-curve check, excluding successive local bend segments. Distinct from the 1.6 mm straight crossing separation; no dielectric or manufacturing tolerance qualification.
